title: Who will win the UFC flyweight title fight at UFC 331?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : UFC's official results or contemporaneous reporting of the flyweight championship bout at UFC 331, scheduled for September 19, 2026. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of that bout on fight night. Subsequent changes to the result will not affect resolution. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning fighter's full name.
